sloka: धर्मविद्धर्मनित्यश्च सत्यसन्धो दृढव्रतः ।आर्ये किम् अब्रवीद् राजा पिता मे सत्य विक्रमः ॥२-७२-३४॥
transliteration: dharmaviddharmanityaśca satyasandho dṛḍhavrataḥ ।ārye kim abravīd rājā pitā me satya vikramaḥ ॥2-72-34॥

translations.english: ﻿﻿﻿ What did my father, the noble king, conversant with righteous conduct, true, to his vows, one who always conducted himself in a righteous manner, whose truth was his prowess (at the time of his death)?
